cap_MlInbox.text:
Capabilities: three-pane-mailbox, global-search, folders-and-labels, work-package-smart-views, work-package-chips, bundled-notifications, keyboard-shortcuts.
What you see: Olivia's inbox with twelve conversations. Linked rows carry their work package chip. The empty reading pane says to select a conversation and lists the shortcuts L, C and /.

cap_MlThread.text:
Capabilities: conversation-view, attachment-list, reply-and-forward, link-to-work-package, work-package-panel, status-change-in-place, work-package-from-mail.
What you see: The Lyon rollout conversation with six messages. On the right the panel for FEATURE #58412, in development and assigned to Tom Achterberg, sits inside the layout instead of over the mail.

cap_MlLinkWorkPackage.text:
Capabilities: work-package-suggestion, link-menu, link-scope, attachments-to-work-package, comment-in-activity.
What you see: Jana's Gantt conversation, not linked yet. The header suggests BUG #58231, and the menu under Link to work package is open with the number typed, three suggestions, the whole conversation selected and both options on.

cap_MlCreateWorkPackage.text:
Capabilities: work-package-from-mail, pre-filled-fields, quoted-description, link-on-create.
What you see: Sven Lindqvist's demo request, with the form New work package from this mail in the panel. Project, type, subject, quoted description, assignee and due date are filled in. Create and link makes the work package and the link in one step.

cap_MlCompose.text:
Capabilities: docked-compose, work-package-chip-in-reply, insert-work-package-reference, set-status-on-send, log-reply-in-activity.
What you see: The Lyon conversation stays readable behind a docked reply to Marc. The reply carries the FEATURE #58412 chip, and above Send you choose a new status and whether the reply is logged in the work package.

cap_MlNotifications.text:
Capabilities: bundled-notifications, comment-from-mail, change-status-from-mail, linked-mail.
What you see: Four bundles, one per work package. The bundle for BUG #58231 is open as a timeline with a comment box, Change status, Open in OpenProject and a line to Jana's conversation.

cap_MlWorkPackageEmails.text:
Capabilities: emails-tab, reply-from-work-package, link-an-email, unlink, mailbox-access.
What you see: OpenProject itself, with BUG #58231 open on the EMAILS tab. It lists Jana's conversation with Reply and Unlink, and a second one the viewer may not read, showing only sender and subject with Ask Priya Raman for access.

cap_MlSearch.text:
Capabilities: global-search, search-filters, work-package-filter, results-per-work-package, search-highlighting.
What you see: The search holds #58231 gantt with the filters open. Results are grouped under BUG #58231 and other matches, with the matching words highlighted, and Jana's conversation is open beside its work package panel.

cap_MlStates.text:
Capabilities: empty-state, loading-skeleton, openproject-unreachable, openproject-sign-in.
What you see: Four miniatures: an empty inbox, skeleton rows while loading, a panel that says OpenProject is not reachable while the mail still works, and a panel that asks you to sign in to OpenProject.

cap_MlSettings.text:
Capabilities: user-settings-dialog, linked-openproject-account, link-suggestions, default-project-rules, link-defaults, notification-bundling.
What you see: The settings dialog over the inbox, on the OpenProject section. It shows the linked instance, two switches, the rules that pick a project per folder or sender, and what happens when you link a mail.

cap_MlMobile.text:
Capabilities: phone-layout, work-package-chips, bottom-app-bar, link-bottom-sheet.
What you see: Three phone frames: the inbox, the Lyon conversation with its work package chip, and the bottom sheet Link to work package with a suggestion and a green Link button.

cap_MlLinkLifecycle.text:
Capabilities: link-lifecycle, link-on-reply, link-on-forward, link-on-move, link-on-delete, mailbox-access.
What you see: Six cards that say what a link does when you link, get a reply, forward, move or archive, delete the mail, or look without access. Each card ends with what the work package shows in OpenProject.
